name: Oil
overview: Scripture reveals oil as a sacred substance with diverse uses, primarily highlighted in the instructions for the tabernacle and anointing practices. The holy anointing oil, made from olive oil and fragrant spices, was carefully consecrated for use in anointing priests and kings, symbolizing God's blessing and sanctification (Exodus 29:7; 30:23-25). Olive oil was also commanded for continual use in the lamp to provide light within the sanctuary, signifying God's enduring presence (Exodus 25:6; 27:20). This sacred oil was set apart from common uses, underscoring the holiness required in worship and leadership.
